# Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo = FALSE}

# set working directory for the whole Rmarkdown (with setwed () it would be just for the current chunk)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/")

```

Load packages.
```{r load packages, echo = FALSE}

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(RCurl)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)

source("/home/marinani/Scripts/Data_analysis/feature_plots.r")

```

```{r load Seurat object}

integrated <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Protocol_comparison/integrated_obj.rds")

```

Subset the microglia-like cells only
```{r}

integrated_mg_only <- subset(integrated, subset = celltype %in% c("smooth muscle cell", "neutrophil", "mast cell"), invert = T)

```


Generate a SingleCellExperiment object from the integrated seurat objects
```{r genearte a SingleCellExperiment object}

# Extract raw counts and metadata to create SingleCellExperiment object
counts <- integrated_mg_only@assays$RNA@counts 

metadata <- integrated_mg_only@meta.data

# Set up metadata as desired for aggregation and DE analysis
metadata$protocol <- factor(integrated_mg_only$protocol)

# Create single cell experiment object
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = counts), 
                           colData = metadata)

```

Take a look at the count matrix
```{r count matrix and metadata}

# Explore the raw counts for the dataset

## Check the assays present
assays(sce)

## Check the counts matrix
dim(counts(sce))
counts(sce)[1:6, 1:6]

# Explore the cellular metadata for the dataset

dim(colData(sce))
head(colData(sce))

```

```{r extract necessary metrics}

# Subset metadata to include only the variables you want to aggregate across (here, we want to aggregate by sample and by cluster)
groups <- colData(sce)[, c("protocol", "celltype")]
head(groups)

```

#### Aggregate matrix
Aggregate the counts to generate a matrix with count sums
```{r generate an aggregated matrix of counts per sample}

# Aggregate across cluster-sample groups
# transposing row/columns to have cell_ids as row names matching those of groups
aggr_counts <- aggregate.Matrix(t(counts(sce)), 
                                groupings = groups, fun = "sum") 

# Explore output matrix
class(aggr_counts)
dim(aggr_counts)
aggr_counts[1:3, 1:10]

# Now transpose the matrix back so we can easilty use it to do DE analysis
# Transpose aggregated matrix to have genes as rows and samples as columns
aggr_counts <- t(aggr_counts)
aggr_counts[1:10, 1:3]

```

Generate matching metadata at the sample-level
```{r}

# Explore structure of metadata
head(colData(sce))

# Extract sample-level variables
metadata <- colData(sce) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(protocol, celltype)

dim(metadata)
head(metadata)

# Exclude duplicated rows
metadata <- metadata[!duplicated(metadata), ]

dim(metadata)
head(metadata)

# Rename rows
rownames(metadata) <- paste0(metadata$protocol,"_", metadata$celltype)
head(metadata)

# Check the number of cells per sample and cluster
t <- table(colData(sce)$protocol)
t
type(t)

aggr_counts[1:10, 1:2]
head(metadata)

# Check matching of matrix columns and metadata rows
all(colnames(aggr_counts) == rownames(metadata)) 
# They do not, so we make them match
metadata <- metadata[match(colnames(aggr_counts), rownames(metadata)), ]

```
#### Differential expression with DESeq2

```{r DESeq2 design formula}

# Create DESeq2 object        
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(aggr_counts, 
                              colData = metadata, 
                              design = ~ celltype + protocol)

```

```{r run DESeq2}

# Run DESeq2 differential expression analysis
dds <- DESeq(dds, useT=TRUE, minmu=1e-6, minReplicatesForReplace =Inf,  test = "LRT", reduced = ~ celltype )

# Plot dispersion estimates
plotDispEsts(dds)

# Check number of rows
nrow(dds)
# Our count matrix contains many rows with only zeros and many roes with only a few fragments total
# To reduce the size of the object and increase the psed of the functions, we remove the rows that have no or nearly no information
# We keep only rows with more than 1 count (i.e. more than one transcript detected)
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 1,]
# Check number of rows
nrow(dds)

```


```{r run vst normaliztion}

library(apeglm)
# Check the coefficients for the comparison
resultsNames(dds)

# Perform transformation in order to stabilize the variance across the mean and reduce the effect the genes with low counts will have on the final result 
# (the genes with high counts are accounted for by taking the logarithm of the normalzied count values + a small pseudocount)
vsd <- vst(dds)
plotPCA(vsd, "protocol")

```

```{r plot}

pdf("Plots/Protocol_comparison/PCA_pseudobulk_per_protocol.pdf", height = 4, width = 6)
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "protocol") + geom_label(aes(label = name), label.size = 0.1) + geom_point()
dev.off()

```

```{r}

# Extract the vst matrix from the object and compute pairwise correlation values
vsd_mat <- assay(vsd)
vsd_cor <- cor(vsd_mat)

# Plot heatmap
pdf("Plots/Protocol_comparison/heatmap_protocol_comparison_similarity.pdf", height = 6, width = 7)
pheatmap(vsd_cor, annotation = metadata[, c("protocol"), drop=F], color=bluered_colscheme(100))
dev.off()

sampleDists <- dist( t( assay(vsd) ) )
sampleDists

sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix( sampleDists ) 
rownames(sampleDistMatrix) <- paste(vsd$protocol) 
colnames(sampleDistMatrix) <- paste(vsd$protocol) 
# colors <- colorRampPalette( rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")) )(255) 

pdf("Plots/Protocol_comparison/heatmap_protocol_comparison_Eucledian_distance.pdf", height = 3.5, width = 6)
pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix,
         clustering_distance_rows=sampleDists,
         clustering_distance_cols=sampleDists,
         col=hcl.colors(50, "BluYl"))
dev.off()

```

#### Results table
```{r build a results table}

resultsNames(dds)

res <- results(dds)
mcols(res, use.names=TRUE)
summary(res)

```

```{r DE Comaprison of interaction terms}

betas <- coef(dds)
colnames(betas)

topGenes <- head(order(res$padj),30)
mat <- betas[topGenes, -c(1,2)]
thr <- 3
mat[mat < -thr] <- -thr
mat[mat > thr] <- thr

pdf("Plots/Protocol_comparison/DESeq2_heatmap_DE_comparison.pdf",  width = 4, height = 8)
pheatmap(mat, breaks=seq(from=-thr, to=thr, length=101),
	  cluster_col=FALSE, color =bluered_colscheme(100)) 
dev.off()

```
```{r}

res_B_M <- results(dds, name = "protocol_McQuade_vs_Brownjohn", test = "Wald")
res_B_M[which.min(res$padj),]

# Turn the DESeq2 results object into a tibble for use with tidyverse functions
res_B_M_tbl <- res_B_M %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(padj)

# Check results output
res_B_M_tbl 

# Set thresholds
padj_cutoff <- 0.5

# Subset the significant results
sig_res <- dplyr::filter(res_B_M_tbl, padj < padj_cutoff) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(padj) %>%
  mutate(DE = abs(log2FoldChange)>log(1.1) & padj < 0.01) %>%
  mutate(DEG = ifelse(abs(log2FoldChange)>log(1.1) & padj < 0.01, gene, NA))

# Check significant genes output
sig_res

# Add to the table another column wtih outcome
sig_res <- sig_res %>% 
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(log2FoldChange > log(1.1) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Up-regulated",
                           log2FoldChange < -log(1.1) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Down-regulated",
                           TRUE ~ "Unchanged")
    )
head(sig_res) 

sig_res$padj[sig_res$padj == 0.000000e+00] <- min(sig_res$padj[which(sig_res$padj != 0)])

# Remove genes coding for mitochondria and ribosome proteins
blacklist <- c(grep("^MT-", sig_res$gene, value=T), read.table("/home/marinani/Scripts/Databases/Gene_lists/RPgenes_bak.txt")[,1])
diff_genes <- setdiff(sig_res$gene,blacklist)
sig_res <- sig_res %>% filter(gene %in% diff_genes)
nrow(sig_res)

plot <- ggplot(sig_res, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj),label=DEG)) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, aes(fill=outcome), position = "jitter") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log(1.1), log(1.1), 0),  linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.01), linetype="dotted") +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#EE9B00", "gray50", "#5F6C25")) +
  xlab(expression("log"[2]*"FC")) + 
  ylab(expression("-log"[10]*"p_adj")) +
  ggtitle("DEGs between Brownjohn and McQuade")


pdf("Plots/Protocol_comparison/DESeq2_volcano_DE.pdf", height = 7, width = 10)
plot +
  geom_label_repel(data = sig_res, mapping = aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(padj), label = DEG), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20)
dev.off()

write.csv(sig_res, "Plots/Protocol_comparison/DESeq2_McQuade_vs_Brownjohn.csv")

```
